snapshot.note: 结果针对当前含大量未提交变更的工作区快照

findings.title: pytest 全局 fixture 直接删除默认业务库用户
evidence: data/app.db modified during audit test run
544 orphan auth sessions; 13 orphan sessions issued on 2026-08-21; 33 audit rows on 2026-08-21
findings.impact: 测试可删除本地真实账号并留下孤儿会话；本次运行已改写默认库
findings.recommendation: 禁止再次运行全量 pytest，直到所有测试数据库路径强制隔离到临时目录；从测试前外部快照比对恢复

findings.title: 主业务数据库存在孤儿关系
evidence: core auth/prompt tables declare no foreign keys
findings.impact: 认证与提示词版本数据不一致，删除和查询语义不可靠
findings.recommendation: 备份后清点孤儿数据，引入版本化外键迁移与启动校验

findings.title: Chroma segments 外键指向不存在的 collection 表
findings.impact: 向量库关系约束失效，迁移、删除和集合加载可能异常
findings.recommendation: 先备份，再按当前 Chroma 版本重建/迁移元数据并验证 foreign_key_check=0

findings.title: 审计日志哈希链未生效且迁移被不可变触发器阻止
findings.impact: 审计记录无法提供声明的防篡改证明，现有迁移路径不可执行
findings.recommendation: 签名密钥缺失时 fail closed；设计可审计的迁移顺序并完成链回填验证

findings.title: 后端测试基线严重破裂
evidence: excluding collection blockers: 224 failed, 1757 passed, 3 skipped in 350.36s
deleted Graph/LangGraph compatibility paths are still imported by tests
findings.impact: 无法证明当前关键业务链路正确，回归信号失真
findings.recommendation: 先恢复 hermetic test baseline，再按根因簇处理真实回归

findings.title: 批量图表提取导入不存在模块
findings.impact: 批量图表提取和间接应用导入失败
findings.recommendation: 统一 canonical 模块名并新增导入/调用测试

findings.title: 前端生产构建有 7 个 TypeScript 错误
evidence: ChatPage.tsx:248,271 null passed to string setter
ChatPage.tsx:526 synchronous callback passed where Promise<void> required
findings.impact: npm run build exits 2; clarification UI cannot be released
findings.recommendation: 修复函数契约与状态类型并重新运行 build

findings.title: 数据库优化 API 与默认 SQLite schema/方言不兼容
evidence: default DATABASE_URL points to data/querymind.db containing only session_metadata
app/database/connection_pool.py:134 uses zip and can silently skip statements
findings.impact: 默认优化与慢查询管理接口返回 500 或静默漏执行
findings.recommendation: 按方言实现、从真实 schema 生成表集合并校验 batch 参数长度

findings.title: 实现与测试/API 契约未同步
evidence: failures span routing, clarification, context, citations, cache isolation, admin APIs, multimodal and RAG profiles
working tree contains extensive uncommitted refactor changes
findings.impact: 部分通过的测试不能代表关键用户链路正确
findings.recommendation: 冻结接口契约并按用户链路恢复端到端回归

findings.title: 存在多套不一致数据库副本且无统一版本迁移
evidence: data/app.db, data/auth.db, data/querymind.db, frontend/data/app.db and two Chroma stores differ
schema evolution relies on CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and ad-hoc ALTER TABLE
findings.impact: 不同工作目录可能读写旧库，schema 漂移不可追踪
findings.recommendation: 只保留 canonical 数据根目录并引入 schema version/migration

findings.title: session_metadata 缺少 2 个代码声明索引
evidence: data/querymind.db has 3 of 5; missing idx_session_category_updated and idx_session_last_query
findings.impact: 常用分类/最近查询路径性能可能退化
findings.recommendation: 纳入版本化迁移并做 schema diff gate

findings.title: 检索质量门禁被 Redis 环境阻塞
findings.impact: 无法得出真实 recall 结论
findings.recommendation: 在带 Redis/索引数据的可复现环境重跑

findings.title: CI 与 lint 工具链不完整
evidence: 660 Python files parsed with zero syntax errors
findings.impact: 重构错误无法在提交阶段被稳定阻断
findings.recommendation: 建立最小 CI 并固定开发依赖

findings.title: 配置示例未覆盖安全与质量关键键
evidence: ADMIN_CREATE_APPROVAL_TOKEN_HASH and RETRIEVAL_PROFILE are not active examples
findings.impact: 默认部署会降级或关闭声明能力
findings.recommendation: 按 backend/profile 提供可验证的模板并在启动时校验

frontend_unit_tests.reason: sandbox denied esbuild access to an ancestor directory

cd frontend && npm test -- --run in a normal local shell with workspace access

feature_suggestions: versioned migrations with backup and post-check

7_days: back up and reconcile orphan data
restore backend collection and frontend build
30_days: add relational constraints and missing indexes
90_days: remove or formally deprecate duplicate stores
automate backup, restore and release gates

summary: 发现 1 个 P0、8 个 P1、5 个 P2。数据库页级结构可读，但业务关系、Chroma 外键和审计哈希链不完整；测试与前端构建均未通过，当前快照不可发布。
